independent_acceptance.reason: Producer execution cannot independently accept its own result.

limitations.statement: Semantic relevance is not inferred from file contents. The builder enforces the caller's frozen allowed tags and rationale declarations.
The mechanism cannot detect a critical source that the request author failed to declare; it proves completeness only against required_sources.
source_locator is recorded provenance but is not fetched or independently resolved. Recurrence rests on verified per-file SHA-256 and the canonical source-snapshot digest.
The byte budget covers admitted source payload bytes, not the generated manifest bytes.
The implementation rejects symlinks and verifies content hashes but does not claim protection against a hostile concurrent filesystem mutation between path checks and reads.
The capsule preserves source bytes and paths, not original permissions, ownership or timestamps.
Cursor reported model gpt-5.6-sol-max-fast, but no separate machine-readable attestation of the requested xhigh reasoning level was exposed.
